# T32 Dental Group

> T32 Dental Group is a multi-specialty dental care provider operating 8 clinics across Singapore with specialist services in orthodontics, implants, and complex restorative dentistry.

T32 Dental Group operates across Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, offering comprehensive dental services from general care to specialized multi-specialty complex dentistry. The group is led by experienced clinical directors and maintains high quality standards with modern dental technology and facilities.

## Key Topics

- Multi-specialty dentistry
- Singapore dental clinics
- Dental specialists
- Orthodontics
- Implant services
- Full-mouth reconstruction
- Teeth whitening
- Sleep apnea dental treatment
- Clinical directors
- Appointment booking
- Dental credentials
- Quality standards
- Regional presence
- Dr. Wong Keng Mun
- T32 Dental Academy
